-2025年6月17日

你好！ 🦌

这是我的用户友好 CivitAi 友好工作流程的第 4 版！

支持 SD1、SDXL、Pony 及其变体！

它再次从头开始完全重建，只是为了好玩！哎哟！

（版本 5 正在开发中，将包含更强大和标准化的功能，例如 ControlNet 功能和更深入的升级，以及我在个人版本中使用的其他方法，请参阅下面的评论）

此工作流程旨在尽可能易于使用，总体目的是在图像上传期间将正确的元数据发送到 CivitAi。基本上，这意味着您的所有资源和 LoRA 将得到正确报告，而无需您执行任何额外操作！

它还旨在具有多种用途，并且易于阅读。它故意不紧凑，以便可以点对点地跟踪所有面条和节点，使其成为将图像保存器功能添加到您自己的工作流程中的学习工具。

它还功能强大，提供现代工作流程中所需的许多易用选项和高分辨率功能。

以下是一些功能 -

  • 烘焙 VAE/自定义 VAE 选择器。只需单击一下即可在 VAE 烘焙或单独文件之间切换。

  • SD 1.5 和 SDXL/PDXL 编码。可与 SD1、SDXL 和 Pony 检查点一起使用。

  • SDXL 风格的通用语句提示。如果您的 SDXL 模型是根据句子使用而不是关键字进行训练的，则可以启用此工作流程来利用它。如果没有，或者您希望使用传统的关键字/标签提示，也只需单击开关即可实现。

  • 多重提示处理。考虑到可用性和可读性，提示被分为几个部分。将细节、风格和乐谱类型提示保存在一个文本框中，而所有场景描述提示则保存在另一个易于阅读和编辑的框中，以便工作流程在运行时自动组合。

  • 二次提示。是否对概念渗透到图像的其他部分有疑问？想要你的拍摄对象有鹿角，但不希望图像中的其他所有东西都神奇地长出奇怪的角？分配辅助提示以更精确地控制图像，并使用权重滑块来确定提示之间的主导地位。

  • SDXL/PDXL 潜在分辨率。编码器可以在调度程序过程中将您的图像视为更高分辨率的图像，从而提供更多的整体细节。您可以轻松选择处理内部分辨率的因素，允许对固定种子图像进行轻微更改，而无需摆弄 CFG 或步骤，并希望它只会稍微改变您的图像。

  • Kohya 深度收缩。另一种高分辨率生成过程，可增加图像的整体尺寸，而不会产生质量、GPU 或平铺错误的成本。之后对图像应用缩小比例（尚未在此工作流程的范围内），会产生比单独生成基本尺寸图像更详细的相似捕获图像。

  • 内置升级器！它升级并相应地调整元数据，哇！

  • 洛拉查找。一种简单易用的方式来查找 LoRA 数据，例如触发器、建议提示和其他有用信息，而无需访问任何网站。当你有一个你不记得的愚蠢命名的文件时，这太棒了！ （感谢 L10n_h34r7）

  • LoRA 为 CivitAi 做报道！！此工作流程会自动将您的所有嵌入和 LoRA 资源记录到元数据中，因此当您准备上传到 CivitAi 时，您将获得与使用现场生成器或 Auto1111 的任何人完全相同的资源列表！感谢所有模型作者，无需任何额外工作！显示您的提示标签！不需要额外的努力！

  • 版本 4 现在会自动更新您的 LoRA！不再需要尝试弄清楚要输入什么内容才能正确保存，工作流程会为您完成所有工作，就像它应该做的那样！

  • Auto1111准备好文件！与 CivitAi 一样，您现在可以将文件直接导入 Auto1111，并让它正确报告您的所有提示、设置、loras 和其他所有内容，让您轻松地从一个 UI 过渡到下一个 UI。

  • 极高的可读性。尽管与以前的版本相比，此工作流程要复杂得多，但我非常小心地确保一切都易于视觉遵循。它是故意分散的而不是紧凑的，以便可以识别每个面条和链接。

  • 注释。我喜欢说话。虽然不像以前的版本那样冗长和直观，但每个过程和步骤都通过大量的符号进行解释。我希望您能稍微理解 comfyUI，但即使没有经验的人也应该能够理解。话虽如此，它并不像版本 3 那样简单 - 相反，我打算作为一个单独的项目为新用户提供一个关于如何运行 ComfyUI 的实际速成课程。

注意 - v4 不再具有图像到图像功能。我删除了它，因为我只是发布一个专注于图像到图像生成的工作流程，能够读取和利用加载图像的元数据。即，它将能够自行传播提示，就像 Auto1111 导入图像的方式一样。 （v3.1 仍然有带有 CivitAi 元数据的 img2img）

该工作流程使用多个节点。我完全建议使用 ComfyUI 管理器来自动安装它们。

我安装了大量自定义节点，老实说，我忘记了哪些节点正在使用，因此这对我和您来说都更容易，但是，根据我的笔记，这些是我在此工作流程中使用的节点的存储库。它应该是正确的，尽管我觉得我可能使用了此列表之外的一两个节点。请随时给我留言，结果确实如此。

使用的存储库 -

https://github.com/alexopus/ComfyUI-Image-Saver

https://github.com/Suzie1/ComfyUI_Comfyroll_CustomNodes

https://github.com/pythongosssss/ComfyUI-Custom-Scripts

https://github.com/rgthree/rgthree-comfy

https://github.com/jitcoder/lora-info

感谢您花时间查看和使用我的工作流程！如果您喜欢它，请在这里留下评分和评论。如果有任何问题或想法，请随时关注或联系我。

我还想将 L10n_h43r7 视为最初的想法。当我尝试使用它时，他们的节点坏了（自定义组节点的事情，不是他们的错），而我试图修复它，这就是整个项目的版本 1 的原因，该版本已经成为它自己的东西。

请随意使用或分解此工作流程，以任何对您有帮助的方式，它是一个学习工具，旨在展示 Image Saver 如何以干净的方式工作，以及一些其他有趣的功能。如果您愿意相信我，那就太好了并且不胜感激，但这不是必需的。

谢谢！

- 基齐🦌

⚠️HI!

So I updated this model to include a small fix to a minor (but breaking) issue caused by one of the nodepacks updating. Everything should work fine again. Thanks!

Also, yes, this works with Illustrious and Noob models.

Also also, I'm working on a more modern public version of my personal workflow, which I've decided to come out of retirement to post at some point in the near future (or next year, who knows c.c).

-Thanks! 🐭

-6/17/2025

Hello! 🦌

This is version 4 of my User Friendly CivitAi Friendly workflow!

Supports SD1, SDXL, Pony, and variants!

It has once again been completely rebuilt from scratch just for fun! Whee!

(version 5 is now in development, and will contain more robust and standardized features, such as ControlNet functions and a more in-depth upscale, as well as additional methods I use in my personal version, see comment below)

This workflow is designed to be as easy to use as possible with the overall intention of sending the correct metadata to CivitAi during image upload. Basically this means all your resources and LoRAs will be reported correctly without you needing to do anything extra!

It also is intended to be vary versatile, and easy to read. It is intentionally not compact so that all the noodles and nodes can be followed point to point, making it a learning tool to add Image Saver functionality to your own workflows.

It is also powerful, offering a lot of ease-of-use options and high resolution functionality expected in a modern workflow.

Here are some features -

  • Baked VAE/Custom VAE selector. Flip between baked in VAE or a separate file with a single click.

  • SD 1.5 and SDXL/PDXL encoding. Can be used with either SD1, SDXL, and Pony checkpoints.

  • SDXL style Generalized Statement prompting. If your SDXL model is trained on sentence use rather than keywords, this workflow is enabled to utilize it. If not, or you wish to use traditional keyword/tag prompts, that is also achievable at just a click of a switch.

  • Multi-prompt handling. Prompts are split into sections for usability and readability in mind. Keep your detail, style, and score type prompts in one text box, while all your scene description prompts are in another easily read and editable box, to be combined by the workflow automatically at runtime.

  • Secondary Prompting. Having a problem with a concept bleeding through to other parts of your image? Want your subject to have antlers, but don't want everything else in the image to magically gain strange horns? Assign a secondary prompt for more preciese control over your image, with a weight slider to determine the dominance between prompts.

  • SDXL/PDXL latent resolution. The encoder can treat your image as if it was a higher resolution during the scheduler process, allowing for more overall detail. You can easily choose the factor at which the internal resolution is processed, allowing for slight changes for fix-seed images without having to fiddle with the CFG or steps and hoping it'll only change your image a little bit.

  • Kohya Deep Shrink. Another high-resolution generating process that increases the overall size of your image without the cost of quality, GPU, or tiling errors. Applying a downscale to your image(not yet in the scope of this workflow) to your image after, results in a similar-seized image with greater detail, than generating a base-sized image alone.

  • Built-in upscaler! It upscales, and adjusts the metadata accordingly, wow!

  • LoRA Lookup. A simple and easy way to look up LoRA data, such as triggers, suggested prompts and other useful info without having to visit any websites. Great when you have a moronically named file you can't remember! (thanks L10n_h34r7)

  • LoRA repeorting for CivitAi!! This workflow automatically records all your embeddings and LoRA resources to the metadata, so when you are ready to upload to CivitAi, you get the very same resource listing as anyone who used the on-site generator or Auto1111! Credit all the model authors without any extra work! Show your prompt tags! No extra effort required!

  • Version 4 now updates your LoRAs automatically! No more trying to figure out what to type to get it to save correctly, the workflow does all the work for you, like it should!

  • Auto1111 ready files! Like CivitAi, you can now import your files directly into Auto1111, and have it correctly report all your prompts, settings, loras, and everything else, allowing you to effortlessly transition from one UI to the next.

  • Extreme readability. Even though this workflow is far more complex when compared to previous versions, I have taken great care to ensure that everything is easy to follow visually. It is intentionally spread out and not compact so that every noodle and link can be identified.

  • Notations. I like to talk. While not as verbose and hand-holding as previous versions, every process and step is explained through extensive notations. I expect you understand comfyUI to a small degree, but even someone with no experience should be able to follow along. That being said, it's not as dumbed down as version 3 - I instead intend to make an actual crash-course in how to run ComfyUI for newer users now as a separate project.

Note - v4 no longer has an Image to Image function. I removed that as I plain to release a focused workflow intent on just image to image generation that is able to read and utilize the metadata of a loaded image. ie, it'll be able to propagate the prompts itself, much like how Auto1111 imports images. (v3.1 still has img2img with CivitAi metadata)

This workflow uses several nodes. I fully suggest the use of ComfyUI manager to install them automatically.

I have a large number of custom nodes installed, and I honestly forget which ones are in use, so this makes it easier for both me and you, however, according to my notes, these are the repositories of the nodes I've used in this workflow. It should be correct, though I feel I might have used a node or two from outside this list. Feel free to message me that turns out to be the case.

Repositories used -

https://github.com/alexopus/ComfyUI-Image-Saver

https://github.com/Suzie1/ComfyUI_Comfyroll_CustomNodes

https://github.com/pythongosssss/ComfyUI-Custom-Scripts

https://github.com/rgthree/rgthree-comfy

https://github.com/jitcoder/lora-info

Thank you for taking the time to look at and use my workflow! If you enjoy it, please leave a rating and a comment here. Also feel free to follow or contact me with any questions or thoughts.

I'd also like to think L10n_h43r7 for the original idea. Theirs broke when I tried to use it (the Custom Group Nodes thing, not their fault) and me trying to fix it is what brought about version 1 of this whole project which has since become its own thing.

Feel free to use or break apart this workflow in whatever way helps you, it is a learning tool and designed to show how Image Saver works in a clean fashion, as well as a few other interesting functions. If you wish to credit me, that'd be wonderful and appreciated, but is not required.

Thanks!

- Kizzi 🦌
